employee_contributions.formula_readable: Participants are immediately 100% vested in their before-tax, Roth 401(k), after-tax, catch-up, rollover, qualified matching, and qualified non-elective contributions and any related investment results.

immediate_vest_triggers: Reaching age 65 while employed by the Company or any of its Affiliates
Death while employed by the Company or any of its Affiliates
Becoming totally disabled (eligible to receive long-term disability benefits under The Prudential Welfare Benefits Plan)
Being a current or former Employee of Assurance IQ (fully vested in Assurance Match Account)
employer_match.formula_readable: Participants become 100% vested in Company Matching Contributions and Discretionary Company Contributions upon completing three years of Vesting Service. Vesting is also accelerated to 100% upon reaching age 65 while employed, death while employed, or becoming totally disabled. Former and current Assurance IQ employees are immediately 100% vested in their Assurance Match Account. If a participant leaves before full vesting, non-vested amounts are forfeited when the Period of Separation reaches five years.

nonelective.formula_readable: Discretionary Company Contributions follow the same vesting schedule as Company Matching Contributions: participants become 100% vested upon completing three years of Vesting Service, reaching age 65 while employed, death while employed, or becoming totally disabled.

nonelective_contribution.formula_readable: The Company may, in its sole discretion, make Qualified Non-Elective Contributions to PESP. If made on a participant's behalf, they are credited to the Qualified Non-Elective Contributions Account and are always fully vested. No specific percentage or formula is stated; the amount and eligibility are at the Company's discretion, and participants will be notified if such a contribution is made.

employer_match.formula_readable: For most Prudential employees, the Company matches 100% of Before-Tax and Roth 401(k) Contributions (excluding Catch-Up Contributions) up to a combined maximum of 4% of Eligible Earnings per payroll period, subject to IRS limits. For Employees of Assurance IQ (effective January 1, 2024), the match rate is 50% of Before-Tax and Roth 401(k) Contributions up to 4% of Eligible Earnings, resulting in a maximum Company match of 2% of Eligible Earnings. Catch-Up Contributions are not matched. A year-end true-up provision applies: if a participant contributes 4% on average over the Plan Year but did not receive a full match in every period, an additional true-up contribution will be made to bring the total Company Matching Contribution to the applicable maximum for the full Plan Year.

eligibility.entry_dates: First day of Employment with the Company
eligibility.formula_readable: Generally, all full-time and part-time Employees of Prudential or Assurance IQ (including Prudential Advisors Financial Professional Associates) are eligible to participate. Employees may enroll at any time starting on their first day of Employment. If hired on or after January 1, 2001 (or for Assurance IQ employees joining on or after August 1, 2023), and no affirmative election to participate or decline is made within 30 days of hire, the employee is automatically enrolled at a 4% contribution rate.
